services.name: Kayaking Tours
services.desc: Enjoy a beautiful and exciting 3 hour scenic float down the Upper Kenai River. This alluring tour allows you to sit back and enjoy spectacular mountain views and wildlife sightings as you wind and weave through the glacier blue waters. Your knowledgeable guide will take you through class I-II rapids, teach you about local history, flora and fauna, and spot some critters along the way! This tour is available for people of all ages and abilities. All raft trips include life jackets, waterproof dry bags, and return transportation to launch site.
